summary_ja: 一つのエクスポージャーに複数の削減手法を用いる場合は、エクスポージャーを分割し、部分ごとに一つの手法を用いる。
summary_en: With several forms of mitigation on one exposure, split the exposure and apply one technique to each part.

sections_en.第六節 第八款: Other Matters Relating to Credit Risk Mitigation Techniques
sections_en.第六節 第八款 第一目: Treatment of Multiple Credit Risk Mitigation Techniques

paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach takes into account the effects of multiple credit risk mitigation techniques for a single exposure, it shall divide the exposure as it chooses into portions to which each credit risk mitigation technique is applied, and use a single credit risk mitigation technique for each divided exposure.
